description: Generates a short video clip from text (PixVerse 3.5).

prompt.description: Prompt for the video generation. node.py: `validate_string(prompt, strip_whitespace=False, min_length=1)`.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the output video.

duration.description: Duration of the output video in seconds. Any value other than 5 silently forces motion_mode='normal' (mirrors node.py:153-154).

dispatch_mode.description: Dispatch mode. "sync" (default) blocks until the job completes. "async" submits the job and returns immediately with a job ID; poll completion via `job_get`. Named `dispatch_mode` (not bare `mode`) so it never collides with provider-specific `mode` knobs (freepik DynamicCombo, pixverse motion mode, meshy pose mode, …).

motion_mode.description: Motion mode. May be silently overridden to 'normal' at body assembly when quality='1080p' or duration_seconds != 5.

negative_prompt.description: Optional text description of undesired elements. node.py widget default is the empty string; wire body drops the field when empty (`negative_prompt if negative_prompt else None`).

pixverse_template.description: Optional template_id from PixverseTemplateNode passthrough. Wire field name is `template_id` per spec.yml.

quality.description: Output video resolution / quality (node.py default '540p'). Setting to '1080p' silently forces motion_mode='normal' and duration_seconds=5 at body assembly (mirrors node.py:150-154).
